messages.subject: Re: Download - How I choose the spacific space to save my output (.txt) using downloadHandler() ?
parts: I believe the download silently fails if you're using the Shiny app from directly within RStudio. Sorry about this. You need to pop it out to your system web browser using the button on the toolbar, then download it from there.
